name: @monet-ui/monet-format
description: Monet — the universal, cross-openable .monet project file format. A thin typed wrapper over the shared Rust `monet-format` crate (compiled to WASM): one envelope every Monet app reads/writes losslessly, with a self-describing per-sequence timeBase and namespaced per-app payload.
author: Monet / monet-ui
//: The format LOGIC lives in the Rust crate at ../../crates/monet-format; this package compiles it to WASM (build:wasm) and wraps it. Call initMonetFormat() once at app startup.

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm --filter @monet-ui/monet-timeline run build && pnpm run build
